items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic skeleton component for text content. Placeholder lines appear while content loads.

items.name: Effect
items.summary: Skeleton loading effects including pulse and shimmer animations. Use pulse for subtle breathing motion or shimmer for a scanning highlight that conveys active content loading.

items.name: Shape
items.summary: Skeleton shape variants including default rectangle, pill, and round. Use pill for button or tag placeholders and round for avatar or icon placeholders to match the final content shape.

items.name: Slotted
items.template: slotting content will hide the skeleton
items.summary: Skeleton with slotted content that automatically hides the placeholder when real content arrives. Use to wrap lazy-loaded content so the skeleton disappears once data loads without manual state management.
